original: Anomaly Type Definitions: Transient deviation >3 sigma, <5 min (single reading >CRIT) is a SPIKE.
formalization: IF a reading deviates more than 3 sigma for less than 5 min THEN AnomalyEvent::Spike.

original: Anomaly Type Definitions: Monotonic deviation >15 min (slope >0.1 sigma/min for 5+ readings) is a DRIFT.
formalization: IF a reading deviates monotonically for more than 15 min THEN AnomalyEvent::Drift.

original: Anomaly Type Definitions: Unchanged >10 consecutive readings is a STUCK sensor.
formalization: IF a reading is unchanged for more than 10 consecutive readings THEN AnomalyEvent::StuckSensor.

original: Anomaly Type Definitions: Sustained WARN violation >10 min (>WARN for 20+ readings) is OUT_OF_RANGE.
formalization: IF a reading exceeds WARN for more than 10 min THEN AnomalyEvent::OutOfRange.

original: Anomaly Type Definitions: An anomaly causally linked to another station with onset within 90 min of the cause is CORRELATED.
formalization: IF an anomaly onset occurs within 90 min of a cause in another station THEN AnomalyEvent::Correlated.

original: Predictive Maintenance - ST04_PACKAGING: VIB DRIFT >0.05 mm/s over 60 min - inspect and lubricate bearing (HIGH).
formalization: IF VIB DRIFT > 0.05 mm/s over 60 min THEN inspect and lubricate bearing IN ST04_PACKAGING

original: Predictive Maintenance - ST02_SEALING: CUR DRIFT >1.0 A for 30+ min - inspect sealing jaw (HIGH).
formalization: IF CUR DRIFT > 1.0 A for more than 30 min THEN inspect sealing jaw IN ST02_SEALING

original: Predictive Maintenance - ST03_LABELLING: TEN STUCK >10 samples - replace sensor (MEDIUM).
formalization: IF TEN STUCK > 10 samples THEN replace sensor IN ST03_LABELLING

original: Predictive Maintenance - ST01_FILLING: PRS <3.3 bar for >15 min - inspect filter and pump (MEDIUM).
formalization: IF PRS < 3.3 bar for more than 15 min THEN inspect filter and pump IN ST01_FILLING

original: Predictive Maintenance - SRV01_SERVERROOM: TMP >25°C for >5 min - activate secondary cooling (CRITICAL).
formalization: IF TMP > 25°C for more than 5 min THEN activate secondary cooling IN SRV01_SERVERROOM

original: Predictive Maintenance - WRH01_WAREHOUSE: TMP DRIFT >2°C over 2 h - inspect compressor; notify QC (CRITICAL).

original: Correlated Fault Resolution: sealing motor overload (ST02_SEALING-CUR up) causes a conveyor speed drop (ST04_PACKAGING-SPD down) via electrical coupling.
formalization: IF ST02_SEALING-CUR increases THEN ST04_PACKAGING-SPD decreases.

original: Correlated Fault Resolution: 1. Verify ST02-CUR trend. 2. Inspect sealing jaw. 3. Reset ST04 speed setpoint.
formalization: IF ST04_PACKAGING-SPD decreases after ST02_SEALING-CUR increases THEN verify ST02-CUR trend, inspect sealing jaw and reset ST04 speed setpoint.

original: Correlated Fault Resolution: server room overheating (SRV01-TMP up) increases SCADA latency.
formalization: IF SRV01-TMP increases THEN SCADA latency increases.

original: Correlated Fault Resolution: increased scan time leads to apparent STUCK readings.
formalization: IF SCADA latency increases THEN apparent STUCK readings occur.

original: Correlated Fault Resolution: 1. Reduce SRV01-TMP <25°C. 2. Verify PLC heartbeats. 3. Clear STUCK alarms.
formalization: IF apparent STUCK readings occur after SRV01-TMP increases THEN reduce SRV01-TMP below 25°C, verify PLC heartbeats and clear STUCK alarms.

original: Correlated Fault Resolution: cold warehouse drift (WRH01-TMP up) creates a product quality risk.
formalization: IF WRH01-TMP increases THEN product quality risk occurs.

original: Correlated Fault Resolution: 1. Restore WRH01-TMP <8°C. 2. Notify QC. 3. Place batch on HOLD in ERP.
formalization: IF WRH01-TMP increases THEN restore WRH01-TMP below 8°C, notify QC and place batch on HOLD in ERP.
